Elu hen hallokin. kol haover al lo taase shechayyavin alav karet veen bo mitat bet din kegon ochel chelev vedam vechametz befesach. vechen kol haover al lo taase shechayyavin alav mita bide shamayim kegon ochel tevel vechohen tame sheachal teruma tehora. vechen kol haover al lav sheyyesh bo maase kegon ochel basar bechalav o lovesh shaatnez. aval lav sheen bo maase kegon holech rachil venokem venoter venose shema shav eno loke: 
Kol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav chutz minnishba umemer umekallel et chavero beshem. vechol lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din kegon lo tinaf lo taase melacha beshabbat en lokin alav. vechol lav shennittan letashlumin kegon lo tigzol velo tignov en lokin alav. vechol lav shennittak laase kegon lo tikkach haem al habbanim lo techalle peat sadcha en lokin alav ella im lo kiyyem ase shebbahen. vechol lav shebbichlalot en lokin alav. ushear kol hallavin shebbattora lokin alehen: 
E zehu lav shebbichlalot ze lav echad shekkolel inyanim harebe kegon lo tochlu al haddam vechen im neemar lo taase davar peloni ufeloni hoil velo yiched lo lav lechol echad veechad mehen en lokin al kol echad veechad ella im ken chalak otah belavin acherim o neemar mippi hashshemua shennechleku. ketzad. kegon ze shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 9)</small> "al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal" eno loke al hanna vehamevushshal shetayim ella achat. uvechadash hu omer <small>(Vayikra 23 14)</small> "velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu" vechayyav al shelashtan shalosh malkiyyot mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze lechallek. hare neemar <small>(Devarim 18 10)</small> "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh kosem kesamim" veaf al pi shekkalal kol hainyanim belav echad hare chalak otam belavin acherim veamar <small>(Vayikra 19 26)</small> "lo tenachashu velo teonenu" melammed shekkol echad mehen belav bifne atzmo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi shellaka bevet din al issur karet velaka paam sheniyya al oto karet atzmo kegon sheachal chelev velaka alav veachal chelev paam sheniyya velaka alav im achal paam shelishit en malkin oto ella machnisin oto lechippa vehu makom tzar kefi komato veeno yachol lishkav bo. venotnin lo lechem tzar umayim lachatz ad sheyyatzeru meav veyichle. veachar kach maachilin oto seorim ad shekkereso nivkaat: 
Mi sheavar al issur karet o mitat bet din vehitru bo vehirkin berosho o shatak velo kibbel alav hateraa. en horgin oto kemo shebbearnu veen malkin oto. chazar veasa kach vehitru bo vehirkin berosho o shatak en memitin oto veen malkin oto. chazar paam shelishit veavar vehitru bo af al pi shehirkin berosho o shatak konsin oto lechippa ad sheyyamut. vechol ellu shello kibbelu alehen hahatraa makkin otan makkat mardut hoil vechatu mikkol makom afillu al issur shel divre sofrim makkin otan makkat mardut: 
Haggonev kele sharet min hammikdash vehamekallel bekosem vehabboel arammit en bet din nizkakin lahen. ella hakkannain pogin bahen vechol shehorgan zacha. vechen kohen sheshshimmesh betuma lo hayu echav hakkohanim meviin oto levet din ella pirche kehunna hayu motziin oto chutz laazara ufotzin et mocho bigzirin. gezerat hakkatuv hi sheen memitin bet din velo malkin et haadam behodaat piv ella al pi shenayim edim. veze sheharag yehoshua achan vedavid leger amaleki behodaat pihem horaat shaa hayta o din malchut haya. aval hassanhedrin en memitin velo malkin hammode baavera shemma nitrefa dato bedavar ze. shemma min haamelin mare nefesh hu hamechakkim lamut shettokin hacharavot bevitnam umashlichin atzman meal haggaggot shemma kach ze yavo veyomar davar shello asa kede sheyyehareg uchelalo shel davar gezerat melech hi:

melech shehirba kesef vezahav: nimtzeu kol hallokim 207 vesiman lahem yilku zedim:

En bet din onshin beomed haddaat ella al pi edim biraya berura. afillu rauhu haedim rodef achar chavero vehitru bo veheelimu enehem o shennichnesu acharav lechurba venichnesu acharav umetzauhu harug umefarper vehassayif menattef dam beyad hahoreg hoil velo rauhu beet shehikkahu en bet din horgin beedut zo veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "venaki vetzaddik al taharog". vechen im heidu alav shenayim sheavad avoda zara ze raahu sheavad et hachamma vehitra bo veze raahu sheavad et hallevana vehitra bo en mitztarfin. shenneemar venaki vetzaddik al taharog hoil veyesh sham tzad lenakkoto velihyoto tzaddik al taharguhu: 
Kol mi sheasa davar shechayyavin alav mitat bet din beones en bet din memitin oto veaf al pi shehaya metzuvve sheyyehareg veal yaavor af al pi shechillel et hashshem vehu anus eno neherag shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 26)</small> "velannaara lo taase davar" zo azhara levet din shello yaanshu et haanus: 
Ish sheanasuhu ad shebba al haerva chayyav mitat bet din sheen kishshuy ella ledaat. aval haishsha hannivelet beones afillu amra achar shenneensa hanichu lo hare hi petura mippene sheyyitzrah nitgabber aleha: 
Asur levet din lachus al hahoreg shello yomru kevar neherag ze uma toelet yesh baharigat haacher venimtzeu mitrashshelin baharigato. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 13)</small> "velo tachos encha alav uviarta dam hannaki". vechen asur levet din lachus al mi shennitchayyev kenas shello yomru ani hu ze shello bechavvana asa ella magbin mimmennu kol sheyyesh lo belo chanina shenneemar velo tachos encha. vechen bedine mamonot en merachamin al haddal. shello tomar ani hu ze uvaal dino ashir hoil vaani veheashir chayyavin lefarneso azakkennu baddin venimtza mitparnes bechavod. al ze hizhira tora <small>(Shemot 23 3)</small> "vedal lo tehdar berivo". veneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "lo tissa fene dal". asur lehadder pene gadol. ketzad. hare shebbau lefanecha shenayim ledin echad chacham gadol veechad hedyot lo takdim lishl bishlomo shel gadol velo tasbir lo panim velo techabbedennu. kede shello yistattemu taanotav shel acher. ella eno nifne leechad mehen ad sheyyiggamer haddin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "lo tehdar pene gadol". amru chachamim al tomar ashir hu ze ben gedolim hu ze heach avayyeshennu veere bevushato. lechach neemar lo tehdar pene gadol: 
Bau lefanecha shenayim echad kasher veechad rasha al tomar hoil verasha hu vechezkato meshakker vechezkat ze sheeno meshanne bidvaro atte haddin al harasha. al ze neemar <small>(Shemot 23 6)</small> "lo tatte mishpat evyoncha berivo" af al pi shehu evyon bemitzvot lo tatte dino: 
<small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "lo taasu avel bammishpat" ze hameavvet et haddin umezakke et hachayyav umechayyev et hazzakkay. vechen hameanne et haddin umaarich bidvarim berurim kede letzaer echad mibbaale dinim hare ze bichlal avel: 
Haggas libbo behoraa vekofetz vechotech et haddin kodem sheyyachkerehu beno leven atzmo ad sheyyehe lo barur kashshemesh hare ze shote rasha vegas ruach. kach tziuu chachamim <small>(gemara sanhedrin 7 2)</small> "hevu metunin baddin". vechen iyyov hu omer <small>(Iyov 29 16)</small> "veriv lo yadati echkerehu": 
Kol dayyan shebba lefanav din vehitchil ledammoto bedin pasuk shekkevar yada oto veyesh bammedina gadol mimmennu bechachma veeno holech venimlach bo hare ze bichlal harshaim shellibbam gas behoraa. veamru chachamim raa al raa tavo lo shekkol haddevarim vechayyotze bahen miggassut haruach hen hammeviot lide iuut haddin. <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "ki rabbim chalalim hippila" ze talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore. <small>(Mishlei 7 26)</small> "vaatzumim kol harugeha" ze shehiggia lehoraa veeno more. vehu sheyyihye haddor tzarich lo. aval im yada sheyyesh lesham rauy lehoraa umana atzmo min hahoraa hare ze meshubbach. vechol hammonea atzmo min haddin monea mimmennu eva vegezel ushevuat shav vehaggas libbo behoraa shote rasha vegas ruach: 
Talmid al yore halacha lifne rabbo ella im ken haya rachok mimmennu shalosh parsaot keneged machane yisrael: 
Al tomar shekkol ellu haddevarim bedin sheyyesh bo hotzaat mamon harebe mizze unetinato laze. leolam yehi din elef mane vedin peruta achat shavin beenecha lechol davar: 
En haddayyanin yoshvin ladin bedin pachot mishsheve peruta. veim huzkeku lishve peruta gomrin et dino afillu lefachot mishsheve peruta: 
Kol hammatte mishpat echad miyyisrael over belav echad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "lo taasu avel bammishpat". veim haya ger over bishne lavin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 17)</small> "lo tatte mishpat ger". veim haya yatom over bishlosha lavin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 17)</small> "mishpat ger yatom":

Mitzvat ase lishpot hashshofet betzedek shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 15)</small> "betzedek tishpot amitecha". e zehu tzedek hammishpat zo hashevayat shene baale dinin bechol davar. lo yehe echad medabber kol tzarko veechad omer lo katztzer devarecha. velo yasbir panim leechad vidabber lo rakkot veyarea panav leacher vidabber lo kashot: 
Shene baale dinin shehaya echad mehem melubbash begadim yekarim vehashsheni melubbash begadim bezuyin omer lamchubbad o halebishehu kemotcha ad shettadun immo o levosh kemoto ad shettihyu shavin achar kach taamdu baddin: 
Lo yihye echad yoshev veechad omed ella shenehem omdim. veim ratzu bet din lehoshiv et shenehem moshivin. velo yeshev echad lemala veechad lematta ella ze betzad ze. bamme devarim amurim bishat massa umattan. aval bishat gemar din shenehem baamida shenneemar <small>(Shemot 18 13)</small> "vayyaamod haam al mshe". vee zehu gemar din ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav. bamme devarim amurim bevaale dinin. aval haedim leolam baamida shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 17)</small> "veamdu shene haanashim": 
Talmid chacham veam haaretz shebbau ledin moshivin et hechacham veomrim leam haaretz shev. im lo yashav en makpidin al kach. velo yakdim hattalmid kesheyyavo ledin veyeshev lifne rabbo kerotze ladun lefanav. veim haya kovea lo zeman likrot uva zemanno muttar: 
Kevar nahagu kol batte dine yisrael meachar haggemara bechol hayeshivot shemmoshivin baale dinin umoshivin haedim kede lesallek hammachaloket. sheen banu koach lehaamid mishpete haddat al tillam: 
Hayu lifne haddayyanim baale din harebe makdimin et din hayyatom ledin haalmana shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 1 17)</small> "shiftu yatom rivu almana". vedin almana kodem ledin talmid chacham. vedin talmid chacham kodem ledin am haaretz. vedin haishsha kodem ledin haish shebboshet haishsha merubba: 
Asur ledayyan lishmoa divre echad mibbaale dinin kodem sheyyavo chavero o shello bifne chavero. vaafillu davar echad asur shenneemar <small>(Devarim 1 16)</small> "shamoa ben achechem". vechol hashshomea meechad over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 1)</small> "lo tissa shema shav". uvichlal lav ze azhara limkabbel lashon hara umesapper lashon hara umeid edut sheker. vechen baal din muzhar shello yashmia devarav laddayyan kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero. vegam al ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak": 
Lo yihye haddayyan shomea mippi hatturgeman ella im ken haya makkir leshon baale dinin veshomea taanotehem. veim eno mahir bilshonam kede lehashiv lahem yaamod hatturgeman lehodia otam pesak haddin umee ze taam chayyav ze vezacha ze: 
Tzarich haddayyan lishmoa taanot baale dinin velishnot taanotehen shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 3 23)</small> "vayyomer hammelech zot omeret ze beni hachay uvenech hammet" umetzaddek et haddin belibbo veachar kach chotcho: 
Minnayin laddayyan shello yease melitz lidvarav shel baal din shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak" ella yomar ma shennire lo veyishtok. velo yelammed echad mibbaale dinin taana kelal. afillu hevi ed echad lo yomar lo en mekabbelin ed echad ella yomar lannitan hare ze heid alecha. halevay sheyyode veyomar emet heid. ad sheyyiton hu veyomar ed echad hu veeno neeman alay. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Raa haddayyan zechut leechad mehen uvaal din mevakkesh leamrah veeno yodea lechabber haddevarim. o sheraahu mitztaer lehatztzil atzmo betaanat emet umippene hachema vehakkaas nistallek mimmennu o nishtabbesh mippene hassichlut. hare ze muttar lesaado meat lahavino techillat haddavar mishshum <small>(Mishlei lo 8)</small> "petach picha leillem". vetzarich lehityashshev bedavar ze harebe shello yihye keorche haddayyanin:

Shennayim shebbau lefanecha ledin echad rach veechad kashe. ad shello tishma et divrehem o mishshettishma et divrehem vei atta yodea lehechan haddin note atta rashshay lomar lahem eni nizkak lachem shemma yitchayyev hakkashe venimtza rodef achar haddayyan. aval mishshettishma et divrehem veteda lehechan haddin note i atta rashshay lomar eni nizkak lachem. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 1 17)</small> "lo taguru mippene ish" shello tomar ish peloni rasha hu shemma yaharog et beni shemma yadlik et gedishi shemma yekatztzetz netiotay. veim haya memunne larabbim chayyav lehizzakek lahem: 
Vechen talmid shehaya yoshev lifne rabbo veraa zechut leani vechova leashir im shatak hare ze over mishshum <small>(Devarim 1 17)</small> "lo taguru mippene ish" veal ze neemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak". uminnayin laddayyan shello yoshiv talmid bur lefanav talmud lomar middevar sheker tirchak: 
Uminnayin letalmid sheraa rabbo shettoe baddin shello yomar amtin lo ad sheyyiggamer haddin veesterenu vaavinennu kede sheyyikkare haddin al shemi talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak": 
Mitzva lomar levaale dinim battechilla bedin attem rotzim o bifshara. im ratzu bifshara osin benehen peshara. vechol bet din sheosin peshara tamid hare ze meshubbach vealav neemar <small>(Zecharya 8 16)</small> "mishpat shalom shiftu beshaarechem" e zehu mishpat sheyyesh immo shalom heve omer ze bitztzua. vechen bedavid hu omer <small>(Shmuel 2 8 15)</small> "vayhi david osho mishpat utzedaka lechol ammo" ezehu mishpat sheyyesh immo tzedaka heve omer zehu bitztzua vehi happeshara. bamme devarim amurim kodem gemar din af al pi sheshshama divrehem veyada lehechan haddin note mitzva livtzoa aval achare sheggamar haddin veamar ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav eno rashshay laasot peshara benehen ella yikkov haddin et hahar: 
Af al pi sheratzu baale haddin bifshara bevet din yesh lahem lachzor velitboa et haddin ad sheyyiknu miyyad shenehem: 
Yafe koach peshara mikkoach haddin sheshshene hedyotot sheddanu en dinehen din veyesh levaale dinin lachzor bahen veim asu peshara vekanu miyyadan en yecholin lachzor bahen: 
Asur leechad min haddayyanim kesheyyetze mibbet din lomar ani hu hamezakke o hamechayyev vachaveray cholkin alay aval ma eese shehem rabbu alay veim amar ken hare hu bichlal holech rachil megalle sod. umaase betalmid echad shehotzi devarim shenneemru bevet hammidrash leachar shetayim veesrim shana vehotziuhu bet din mibbet hammidrash vehichrizu alav ze megalle sod hu: 
Shaal echad mibbaale dinim lichtov lo pesak din kotvin lo kach ba peloni levet din shel peloni im peloni baal dino shetteano bechach veyatza zakkay o chayyav venotnin lo veen mazkirin shem hamezakkin velo shem hamechayyevin ella bet din shel peloni middivrehem nizdakka peloni: 
Kach haya minhagam shel anshe yerushalayim. machnisin baale dinin veshomim divrehem vetaanotehem umachnisim haedim veshomim divrehem. umotziin kol adam lachutz. vehaddayyanim nosim venotnim benehem baddavar vegomrin et haddavar veachar kach machnisin baale dinim vegadol shebbaddayyanim omer ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav kede shello yeda echad mibbaale dinim e ze dayyan hu mi shezzikka oto velo e ze dayyan hu shechiyyevo: 
Dayyan shehu yodea bachavero shehu gazlan o rasha asur lehitztaref immo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak". vechach hayu nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim osin en yoshvin baddin ad sheyyedu im mi hem yoshvim velo chotmim et hashshetar ad sheyyedu mi chotem immahem velo nichnasim lisuda ad sheyyedu mi mesev immahen:

<small>(Devarim 16 19)</small> "lo tikkach shochad" en tzarich lomar leavvet et haddin ella afillu lezakkot et hazzakkay ulechayyev et hachayyav asur veover belo taase. vahare hu bichlal arur lokeach shochad. vechayyav lehachezir hashshochad kesheyyitbaennu hannoten: 
Ucheshem shehallokeach over belo taase kach hannoten. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl": 
Kol dayyan sheyyoshev umegaddel maalato kede leharebot sachar lechazzanav ulesofrav hare hu bichlal hannotim achare habbetza. vechen asu bene shemuel ulechach neemar lahem <small>(Shmuel 1 8 3)</small> "vayyittu achare habbatza vayyikchu shochad". velo shochad mamon bilvad ella afillu shochad devarim. umaase bedayyan echad shehaya ole bedugit ketanna laavor bannahar ufashat echad yado vesiyyeo baaliyyato vehaya lo din veamar lo haddayyan hareni pasul lecha ladin. umaase beechad sheheevir evra notza shel of meal redid haddayyan veachar kissa rok millifne haddayyan veamar lo hareni pasul lecha ladin. umaase beechad shehevi mattana achat mimmattenot kehunna ledayyan kohen veamar lo pasul ani lecha ladin. umaase bearis echad shel dayyan shehaya mevi lo teenim mittoch sadehu meerev shabbat leerev shabbat paam achat hikdim vehevi bachamishi beshabbat mippene shehaya lo din veamar lo haddayyan hareni pasul lecha ladin af al pi shehatteenim mishshel dayyan hoil vehevian shello bizmannam nifsal lo ladin: 
Kol dayyan sheshshaal sheela pasul ladin laze shehishilo. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lo laddayyan lehasheil aval haya lo lehasheil kasher shehare gam ze shoel mimmennu: 
Kol dayyan shennotel secharo ladun dinav betelim. vehu shello yihye sachar hannikkar. aval im haya osek bimlachto uvau lefanav shenayim ledin veamar lahen tenu li mi sheyyaase tachtay ad sheadun lachem o tenu li sachar battalati hare ze muttar. vehu sheyyihye haddavar nikkar shehu sechar habbattala bilvad velo yoter. veyittol mishshenehem beshave ze bifne ze. kegon ze muttar: 
Asur laddayyan ladun lemi shehu ohavo af al pi sheeno shoshvino velo reo asher kenafsho velo lemi shessono af al pi sheeno oyev lo velo mevakkesh raato ella tzarich sheyyihyu shene baale dinim shavin beene haddayyanim uvelibbam. veim lo haya makkir et echad mehem velo maasav en lecha dayyan tzedek kamohu: 
Kol shene talmide chachamim shessonim ze et ze asurin leshev baddin ze im ze. sheddavar ze gorem litziat mishpat meukkal. mippene hassina shebbenehen daat kol echad nota listor divre chavero: 
Leolam yire dayyan atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo al tzavvaro vegehinnom petucha lo mittachtav. veyeda et mi hu dan velifne mi hu dan umi atid lehippara mimmennu im nata mikkav haemet shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 82 1)</small> "elohim nitztzav baadat el". veomer <small>(divrei hayamim 2 19 6)</small> "reu ma attem osim ki lo leadam tishpetu ki laAdonai": 
Kol dayyan sheeno dan din emet laamitto gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael. vechol dayyan shennotel mizze venoten laze shello kaddin hakkadosh baruch hu gove mimmennu nefashot shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 22 23)</small> "vekava et kovehem nafesh". vechol dayyan sheddan din emet laamitto afillu shaa achat keillu tikken et kol haolam kullo vegorem lashshechina shettishre beyisrael shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 82 1)</small> "elohim nitztzav baadat el". veshemma yomar haddayyan ma li velatztzara hazzot talmud lomar <small>(divrei hayamim 2 19 6)</small> "veimmachem bidvar mishpat". en laddayyan ella ma sheenav root: 
Vlolam yihyu baale dinin lefanecha kirshaim uvechezkat shekkol echad mehen toen sheker vedun lefi ma shettire min haddevarim. uchesheyyippatru millefanecha yihyu beenecha ketzaddikim keshekkibbelu alehem et haddin vedun kol echad mehem lechaf zechut:

Yesh laddayyan ladun bedine mamonot al pi haddevarim sheddato nota lahen shehen emet vehaddavar chazak belibbo shehu ken af al pi sheen sham reaya berura veen tzarich lomar im haya yodea bevadday shehaddavar ken hu shehu dan kefi ma sheyyodea. ketzad. hare shennitchayyev adam shevua bevet din veamar laddayyan adam shehu neeman etzlo vesheddato somechet al devarav shezze haish chashud al hashshevua yesh laddayyan lahafoch hashshevua al shekkenegdo veyishshava veyittol hoil vesamcha dato shel dayyan al divre ze. afillu hayta ishsha o eved neemanim etzlo hoil umatza haddavar chazak venachon belibbo somech alav vedan. veen tzarich lomar im yada hu atzmo shezze chashud. vechen im yatza shetar chov lefanav veamar lo adam shessamach alav afillu ishsha o karov ze parua hu im samcha dato al devarav yesh lo lomar laze lo tippara ella bishvua. o im haya alav shetar chov leacher yitten leze shello nifgam shetaro kelal veyanniach ze shennifgam shetaro bedivre haechad o yashlich hashshetar befanav velo yadun bo kefi ma sheyyire. vechen mi shebba vetaan sheyyesh lo pikkadon etzel peloni shemmet belo tzavvaa venatan simanin muvhakin velo haya ze hattoen ragil lehikkanes bevet ze haish shemmet. im yada haddayyan shezze hammet eno amud lihyot lo chefetz ze vesamcha dato sheen ze hachefetz shel met motzio min hayyorshin venotno leze haamud bo venatan simanim. vechen kol kayyotze baze sheen haddavar masur ella lelibbo shel dayyan lefi ma sheyyerae lo shehu din haemet. im ken lamma hitzricha tora shene edim shebbizman sheyyavou lifne haddayyan shene edim yadun al pi edutan af al pi sheeno yodea im beemet heidu o besheker:

Kol ellu haddevarim hen ikkar haddin. aval mishsherabbu batte dinin sheenan hagunim vaafillu hayu hagunim bemaasehem enan chachamim karauy uvaale bina hiskimu rov batte dine yisrael shello yehappechu shevua ella biraya berura. velo yifgemu shetar veyafsidu chezkato beedut ishsha o pasul vechen bishar kol haddinin velo yadun haddayyan bismichat dato velo bidiato kede shello yomar kol hedyot libbi maamin ledivre ze vedati somechet al ze. vechen en motziin min hayetomim ella biraya berura lo bedaat haddayyan velo beumdan hammet o hattoen. veaf al pi chen im heid adam neeman bedavar mikkol haddevarim venatta daat haddayyan sheemet hu omer mamtin baddin veeno doche eduto venose venoten im baale dinin ad sheyyodu ledivre haed o yaasu peshara o yistallek min haddin:

Uminnayin ledayyan shehu yodea bedin shehu merumme shello yomar echtechennu veyihye hakkolar taluy betzavvere haedim. talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 23 7)</small> "middevar sheker tirchak". ketzad yaase. yidrosh bo veyachkor harebe bidrisha uvachakira shel dine nefashot im nire lo lefi dato [sheen bo rammaut chotech et haddin al pi haedut aval im haya libbo nokfo] sheyyesh bo rammaut o sheen dato somechet al divre haedim af al pi sheeno yachol lefaslan o sheddato nota shebbaal din ze rammay uvaal arma vehishshi et haedim af al pi shehem kesherim ulefi tummam heidu veze hattaam o shennire lo mikkelal haddevarim sheyyesh sham devarim acherim mesuttarin veenan rotzim legallotam. kol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen asur lo lachtoch oto haddin ella yesallek atzmo middin ze vidinennu mi shellibbo shalem baddavar. vahare haddevarim mesurim lallev vehakkatuv omer <small>(Devarim 1 17)</small> "ki hammishpat lelohim hu":

Yesh levet din lehalekot mi sheeno mechuyyav malkot velaharog mi sheeno mechuyyav mita velo laavor al divre tora ella laasot seyag lattora. vechevan sheroim bet din sheppartzu haam baddavar yesh lahen ligdor ulechazzek haddavar kefi ma sheyyerae lahem hakkol horaat shaa lo sheyyikba halacha ledorot. maase vehilku adam shebbaal ishto tachat ilan. umaase beechad sherachav al sus beshabbat bime yevanim veheviuhu levet din usekaluhu. umaase vetala shimon ben shetach shemonim nashim beyom echad beashkelon velo hayu sham kol darche hadderisha vachakira vehahatraa velo beedut berura ella horaat shaa kefi ma sheraa:

Vechen yesh levet din bechol makom uvechol zeman lehalekot adam sheshshemuato raa vehaam merannenim alav shehu over al haarayot vehu sheyyihye kol sheeno posek kemo shebbearnu velo yihyu ellu oyvim yeduim shemmotziin alav shemua raa. vechen mevazzin et ze sheshshemuato raa umecharfin et yoladto befanav:

Vechen yesh laddayyan tamid lehafekir mamon sheyyesh lo bealim umeabbed venoten kefi ma sheyyire ligdor peratzot haddat ulechazzek habbedek o liknos allam ze vahare hu omer beezra <small>(Ezra 10 8)</small> "vechl asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim kaatzat hassarim vehazzekenim yochoram kol rechusho" mikkan shehefker bet din hefker:

Vechen yesh laddayyan lenaddot ulehacharim mi sheeno ben nidduy kede ligdor peretz kefi ma sheyyerae lo vehashshaa tzericha lechach veyomar shenniddahu vehechrimahu al dato vifarsem cheto barabbim shenneemar <small>(Shoftim 5 23)</small> "oru meroz amar malach Adonai oru aror yshveha ki lo vau leezrat Adonai":

Vechen yesh laddayyan laasot meriva im harauy lariv immo ulekallelo ulehakkoto velitlosh searo ulehashbia belohim beal karcho shello yaase o shello asa. shenneemar <small>(Nechemya 13 25)</small> "vaariv immam vaakallem vaakke mehem anashim vaemretem vaashbiem belohim":
Vechen yesh lo lichpot yadayim veraglayim veleesor bevet haasurim velidchof velischov al haaretz shenneemar <small>(Ezra 7 26)</small> "hen lemot hen lishroshi hen laanash nichsin veleesurin":

Kol ellu haddevarim lefi ma sheyyire haddayyan shezze rauy lechach veshehashshaa tzericha. uvakkol yihyu maasav leshem shamayim veal yihye kevod habberiyyot kal beenav shehare hu doche et lo taase shel divrehem vechol shekken kevod bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov hammachazikin betorat haemet sheyyihye zahir shello yaharos kevodam ella lehosif bichvod hammakom bilvad shekkol hamevazze et hattora gufo mechullal al habberiyyot vehamechabbed et hattora gufo mechubbad al habberiyyot. veen kevod hattora ella laasot al pi chukkeha umishpateha:

Asur laadam linhog bisrara al hatztzibbur uvegassut haruach ella baanava veyira. vechol parnas hammattil ema yetera al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim neenash. veeno roe lo ben talmid chacham shenneemar <small>(Iyov 37 24)</small> "lachen yereuhu anashim lo yire kol chachme lev":

Vechen asur lo linhog bahen kallut rosh af al pi shehen amme haaretz. velo yafsia al rashe am hakkodesh. af al pi shehen hedyotot ushefalim bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov hem vetzivot hashshem shehotzi meeretz mitzrayim bechoach gadol uveyad chazaka. vesovel torach hatztzibbur umassaan kemoshe rabbenu. shenneemar bo kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek. vahare hu omer <small>(Devarim 1 16)</small> "vaatzavve et shoftechem" zo azhara laddayyan sheyyisbol et hatztzibbur <small>(Bamidbar 11 12)</small> "kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek". tze ulemad mimmoshe rabban shel kol hanneviim kevan sheshshelacho hakkadosh baruch hu bemitzrayim veneemar <small>(Shemot 6 13)</small> "vaytzavvem el bene yisrael" amru mippi hakkabbala sheamar lahem lemoshe uleaharon al menat sheyyihyu mekallelim etchem vesoklin etchem baavanim:

Kederech shennitztavva haddayyan linhog bemitzva zo kach nitztauu hatztzibbur linhog kavod baddayyan. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 1 18)</small> "vaatzavve etchem" zo azhara latztzibbur shettihye emat haddayyan alehen velo yitbazze bifnehem velo yinhog kallut rosh beatzmo:

Kevan shennitmanna adam parnas al hatztzibbur asur baasiyyat melacha bifne shelosha kede shello yitbazze bifnehem. im hammelacha barabbim asura alav kal vachomer leechol velishtot ulehishtakker bifne rabbim uvichnisat amme haaretz uvisudat mereut. oy lahem leotan haddayyanim shennahagu bechach meelbon torat moshe shebbizzu dineha vehishpiluha ad eretz vehiggiuha ad afar vegarmu raa lahen velivne benehem baolam hazze velaolam habba:

Asur linhog kallut rosh beshaliach bet din vahare hashshaliach neeman kishnayim leinyan hannidduy. sheim amar peloni hiklani o hikla haddayyan o lo ratza lavo ledin meshammetin oto al piv. aval en kotvin pitcha alav ad sheyyavou shenayim veyaidu alav shennimna lavo levet din:
En shaliach bet din chayyav baamirat devarim mishshum lashon hara. vechol hametzaer shaliach bet din yesh levet din reshut lehakkoto makkat mardut:

Shaliach sheamar peloni shelachani beshem echad min haddayyanim velo ratza baal din lavo en kotvin alav pitcha shel shamta ad sheyyomar mishshem shelashtan. bamme devarim amurim shehalach hashshaliach beyom sheeno yadua lishivat haddayyanim. aval bayyom hayyadua shehaddayyanim yoshvim bo ledin hakkol yodim shekkol haddayyanim mekubbatzin veaf al pi shebba hashshaliach beshem echad keillu ba beshem shelashtan:

Mi sheshshalchu lo bet din lavo velo ba laddin menaddin oto vechotvin alav pitcha venoten sechar hassofer uvaet sheyyavo korin happitcha. katvu lo pitcha mippene shello kibbel haddin kevan sheamar hareni mekabbel haddin korin nidduyo. kavu lo bet din zeman sheyyavo hayyom velo ba kol oto hayyom kotvin alav pitcha laerev. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya bammedina umarad velo ba. aval im haya bakkefarim veyotze venichnas kovim lo zeman sheni vachamishi vesheni. veim shalam yom sheni velo ba en kotvin alav pitcha ad lemachar:

En kovin zeman lo bime nisan velo bime tishre mippene shehaam terudin bemoadot. velo beerev shabbat velo beerev yom tov. aval kovin benisan sheyyavo achar nisan uvetishre sheyyavo achar tishre. aval lo kovin beerev shabbat sheyyavo achar shabbat mippene shehakkol terudin beerev shabbat:

Mi shehu bammedina vehalach shaliach bet din velo metzao en kovin lo zeman ad sheyyimtza oto hashshaliach veyomar lo. haya bichfar chutz lammedina im darko lavo beoto hayyom omer hashshaliach afillu leechad min hashshechenim afillu leishsha im yavo peloni hodiuhu shebbet din kavu lo zeman sheyyavo levet din. veim lo ba menaddin oto laerev. bamme devarim amurim kesheen hadderech sheddarko lelech bah al mekom bet din aval im darko alehen en menaddin oto ad sheyyodio hashshaliach beatzmo shemma lo amru lo hashshechenim. shehare hem omrin darko al petach bet din uchevar halach alehem veniftar. vechen im lo ba bammedina ad lemachar en somchin al hashshechenim shemma shachchu velo amru lo:

Mi shebba levet din vekibbel haddin veamru lo leshallem vehalach velo shillem en menaddin oto ad sheyyatru bo sheni vachamishi vesheni. veachar kach menaddin oto ad sheyyitten ma shehu chayyav. veim amad sheloshim yom velo tava lehattir nidduyo machrimin oto:

Kol hamekallel dayyan middayyane yisrael over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 27)</small> "elohim lo tekallel". vechen im killel hannasi echad rosh sanhedri gedola o hammelech hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 27)</small> "venasi veammecha lo taor". velo dayyan venasi bilvad ella kol hamekallel echad miyyisrael loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "lo tekallel cheresh". velamma neemar cheresh sheafillu ze shehu eno shomea velo nitztaer biklala zo loke al killato. veyerae li shehamekallel et hakkatan hannichlam loke (hare hu checheresh):

Hamekallel et hammet patur. hoil umekallel kol adam miyyisrael chayyav lamma yiched lav al dayyan velav al nasi lechayyevo shetayim. nimtzeta lamed shehamekallel echad miyyisrael ben ish ben ishsha ben gadol ben katan loke achat. veim killel dayyan loke shetayim. veim killel nasi loke shalosh. uven nasi shekkillel aviv chayyav mishshum arbaa shemot. shelosha shel kol adam veechad mishshum haav:

Hamekallel atzmo loke kemo shekkillel acherim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 9)</small> "hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha". veechad hamekallel atzmo o chavero o nasi o dayyan eno loke ad sheyyekallel beshem min hashshemot. kegon yah velohim veshadday vechayyotze bahen. o bechinnuy min hakkinnuyim kegon channun vekanno vechayyotze bahen. hoil vehu chayyav im killel bechol hakkinnuyim kach im killel bechol lashon chayyav shehashshemot shekkorin bahen haggoyim lehakkadosh baruch hu hare hen kechol hakkinnuyim. vearur bo shevua bo kelala bo nidduy:

Eno loke ad sheyyatru bo bifne edim kishar kol chayyave lavin. aval im lo hayta sham hateraa o shekkillel belo shem uvelo kinnuy kegon sheamar arur peloni o shehayta hakkelala baa mikkelal haddevarim kegon sheamar al yehi peloni baruch laAdonai o al yevarchehu el vechayyotze bidvarim ellu eno loke:

Af al pi sheeno loke im cheref talmid chacham menaddin oto. veim ratzu haddayyanim lehakkoto makkat mardut makkin veonshin oto kefi ma sheyyiru shehare bizza et hazzaken. veim cheref am haaretz onshin haddayyanim baddavar kefi ma shehashshaa tzericha lo lefi hamecharef ulefi ze shennitcharef:

Af al pi sheyyesh lo laddayyan o lannasi limchol al kevodo eno yachol limchol al killato. vechen shear haam af al pi shemmachal hamekullal malkin et hamekallel shekkevar chata venitchayyev. aval mi shennitchayyev nidduy mippene shehifkir bevet din veratzu bet din limchol al kevodan velo nidduhu harshut beyadan. vehu shello yihye baddavar hefsed bichvod habbore. kegon shehayu haam mevaatin bedivre tora uvaddayyanim hoil ufakru haam baddavar tzerichin lechazzek velaanosh kefi ma sheyyerae lahem:

Kol haddan bedayyane akkum uvearkaot shellahen af al pi shehayu dinehem kedine yisrael hare ze rasha ucheillu cheref vegiddef veherim yad betorat moshe rabbenu shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 1)</small> "veelle hammishpatim asher tasim lifnehem" lifnehem velo lifne akkum lifnehem velo lifne hedyotot. hayta yad haakkum takkifa uvaal dino allam veeno yachol lehotzi mimmennu bedayyane yisrael yitbaennu ledayyane yisrael techilla. im lo ratza lavo notel reshut mibbet din umatztzil bedayyane akkum miyyad baal dino: seliku lehu hilchot sanhedrin besad
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 1: Haed metzuvve lehaid bevet din bechol edut sheyyodea. ben beedut sheyyechayyev bah et chavero ben beedut sheyyezakkehu bo. vehu sheyyitbaennu lehaid bedine mamonot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "vehu ed o raa o yada im lo yaggid venasa avono":

Haya haed chacham gadol vehaya bevet din pachut mimmennu bechachma. hoil veen kevodo sheyyelech lifnehem ase shel kevod tora adif veyesh lo lehimmana. bamme devarim amurim beedut mamon. aval beedut shemmafrish bah min haissur vechen beedut nefashot o makkot holech umeid shenneemar <small>(gemara berachot 19 2)</small> "en chachma veen tevuna leneged Adonai". kol makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav:
Kohen gadol eno chayyav lehaid ella edut shehi lemelech yisrael bilvad. holech levet din haggadol umeid bah. aval bishar haeduyyot patur:

Mitzvat ase lidrosh et haedim ulechakran uleharbot bishelatan umedakdekin alehen umassiin otan meinyan leinyan beet hashsheela kede sheyyishteku o yachzeru bahen im yesh beedutan dofi. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 15)</small> "vedarashta vechakarta veshaalta hetev". utzerichin haddayyanim lehizzaher beet chakirat haedim [shemma mittochah yilmedu leshakker. uvesheva chakirot bodkin otam]. bee zo shavua. bee zo shana. bee ze chodesh. bechamma bechodesh. bee ze yom mime hashshabbat. uvechamma shaot bayyom. uvee ze makom. afillu amar hayyom harago o emesh harago shoalin lahen bee ze shavua bee zo shana bee ze chodesh bechamma bachodesh bee ze yom bee zo shaa. umikkelal hachakirot yeter al hashsheva hashshavot bakkol sheim heidu alav sheavad avoda zara shoalin lahen et me avad uvee zo avoda avad. heidu shechillel et hashshabbat shoalin otan e zo melacha asa veheach asa. heidu sheachal beyom hakkippurim shoalin otan e ze maachol achal vechamma achal. heidu sheharag et hannefesh shoalin otan bamme harago. vechen kol kayyotze baze hare hu mikkelal hachakirot:

Hachakirot vehadderishot hen haddevarim shehen ikkar haedut uvahen yitchayyev o yippater. vehen kavvanat hammaase sheasa vechiuun hazzeman vechiuun hammakom shebbahen yazommu haedim o lo yazommu. sheen anu yecholim lehazim haedim ad sheyyechavvenu hazzeman vehammakom:

Veod marbin livdok haedim bidvarim sheenan ikkar baedut veenah teluya bahem. vehem hannikraim bedikot. vechol hammarbe bivdikot hare ze meshubbach. ketzad hen habbedikot. hare sheheidu alav sheharag venechkeru besheva chakirot shemmaninu. shehen bechavvanat hazzeman vechavvanat hammakom. venidreshu bechavvanat hammaase vechivvenu hammaase vechivvenu hakkeli sheharago bo. bodkin otan od veomrim lahen me haya levush hanneherag o hahoreg. begadim levanim o shechorim. afar haaretz shenneherag aleha lavan o adom. ellu vechayyotze bahen hem habbedikot. maase sheamru haedim harago bemakom peloni tachat hatteena uvadku haedim veamru lahem teenim shellah shechorot hayu o levanot uktzin shel otam hatteenim arukkot hayu o ketzarot. vechol hammarbe bivdikot vechayyotze bahen hare ze meshubbach:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 2:
Ma ben chakirot uderishot livdikot. bachakirot uderishot im kivven haechad et eduto vehashsheni omer eni yodea edutan betela. aval bivdikot afillu shenehen omrin en anu yodin edutan kayyemet. uvizman shehen machchishin ze et ze afillu bivdikot edutan betela. ketzad. heidu sheharag ze et ze veamar haechad keshennechkar beshavua peloni. beshana pelonit. bechodesh peloni. bechach vechach bechodesh. birvii beshabbat. beshesh shaot bayyom. bemakom peloni harago. vechen kesheddarshu bamme harago amar harago besayif. vechen haed hashsheni kivven eduto bakkol chutz min hashshaot sheamar eni yodea bechamma shaot haya bayyom. o shekkivven et hashshaot veamar eni yodea bamme harago velo hevanti bakkeli shehaya beyado. hare edutan betela. aval im kivvenu hakkol veamru lahen haddayyanim kelav hayu shechorim o levanim veamru en anu yodim velo samnu libbenu lidvarim ellu sheen bahen mammash hare edutan kayyemet: 
Amar echad kelim shechorim haya lavush vehashsheni amar lo chen ella levanim haya lavush hare edutan betela. ucheillu amar echad birvii beshabbat vehashsheni bachamishi sheen kan edut. o sheamar haechad besayif harago vehashsheni amar beromach sheen kan edut. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 15)</small> "nachon haddavar" vechevan shehichchishu ze et ze bee ze mikkol haddevarim en ze nachon: 
Hayu haedim merubbim shenayim mehen kivvenu edutan bachakirot uvidrishot vehashshelishi omer eni yodea titkayyem haedut bishnayim veyehareg. aval im hichchish et shenehen afillu bivdikot edutan betela: 
Ed echad omer birvii beshabbat bishnayim lachodesh vehashsheni omer birvii beshabbat bishlosha lachodesh edutan kayyemet. shezze yodea beibburo shel chodesh veze eno yodea. bamme devarim amurim ad chatzot hachodesh. aval achar chatzot hachodesh kegon sheamar haechad beshishsha asar bachodesh vehashsheni omer beshiva asar bachodesh af al pi shekkivvenu shenehem yom echad mime hashshabbat edutan betela. sheen chatzi hachodesh ba uchevar yadu hakkol ematay haya rosh hachodesh: 
Amar haechad bishlosha vehashsheni omer bachamishsha edutan betela. amar ed echad bishte shaot bayyom vehashsheni omer beshalosh shaot hare edutan kayyemet shedderech haam litot beshaa achat. aval im amar haechad beshalosh shaot vehashsheni omer bechamesh edutan betela. amar ed echad kodem hanetz hachamma veechad omer behanetz hachamma edutan betela af al pi shehi shaa achat shehaddavar nikkar lakkol. vechen im nechleku bishkiatah:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 3:
Echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha vachakira. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 24 22)</small> "mishpat echad yihye lachem". aval amru chachamim kede shello tinol delet bifne loyn en ede mamon tzerichin derisha vachakira. ketzad. amru haedim befanenu hilva ze et ze mane beshana pelonit. af al pi shello kivvenu et hachodesh velo et hammakom shehilva bo velo et hammane im haya mimmatbea peloni o mimmatbea peloni edutan kayyemet: 
Bamme devarim amurim behodaot vehalevaot mattanot umechirot vechayyotze bahen. aval bedine kenasot tzerichin derisha vachakira veen tzarich lomar bemalkot uvegalut. vechen im raa haddayyan shehaddin merumme vechashash lo tzarich derisha vachakira: 
Af al pi sheen ede mamonot tzerichin derisha vachakira im hichchishu haedim ze et ze bidrishot o bachakirot edutan betela. veim hichchishu haedim ze et ze bivdikot edutan kayyemet. ketzad. echad omer benisan lava mimmennu vehashsheni omer lo ki ella beiyyar o sheamar haechad birushalayim vehashsheni omer lo ki ella belod hayinu edutan betela. vechen im amar haechad chavit shel yayin hilvahu vehashsheni omer shel shemen hayta edutan betela shehare hichchisho bidrisha. aval im amar haechad mane shachor vehashsheni omer mane lavan haya. ze omer baddeyota haelyona hayu keshehilvahu vehashsheni omer baddeyota hattachtona hayu. edutan kayyemet. afillu amar haechad mane hilvahu vehashsheni omer matayim chayyav leshallem mane sheyyesh bichlal matayim mane. vechen im amar haechad deme chavit shel yayin yesh lo beyado veze omer deme chavit shel shemen meshallem bappachut shebbedamim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Din tora sheen mekabbelin edut lo bedine mamonot velo bedine nefashot ella mippi haedim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 6)</small> "al pi shenayim edim" mippihem velo mikketav yadan. aval middivre sofrim shechotchin dine mamonot beedut shebbashshetar af al pi sheen haedim kayyamim kede shello tinol delet bifne loyn. veen danin beedut shebbashshetar bedine kenasot veen tzarich lomar bemakkot uvegalut ella mippihen velo mikketav yadan: 
Kol ed shennechkera eduto bevet din ben bedine mamonot ben bedine nefashot en yachol lachzor bo. ketzad. amar mute hayiti shogeg hayiti venizkarti sheen haddavar ken. lefachdo asiti. en shomin lo afillu natan taam lidvarav. vechen eno yachol lehosif beeduto tenay. kelalo shel davar kol devarim sheyyomar haed achar shennechkera eduto sheyyavo mikkelalan bittul haedut o hosafat tenay bah en shomin lo: 
Edim hachatumim al hashshetar hare hen kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din veen yecholin lachzor bahen. bamme devarim amurim kesheefshar lekayyem hashshetar shello mippihen kegon shehayu sham edim shezze ketav yadan o shehaya ketav yadan yotze mimmakom acher. aval im i efshar lekayyem et hashshetar ella mippihen veamru ketav yadenu hu ze aval anusim hayinu ketannim hayinu kerovim hayinu mutim hayinu hare ellu neemanim vivattel hashshetar: 
Amru pesule edut hayinu baavera o shochad lakachnu al edut zo en neemanim sheen adam mesim atzmo rasha ad sheyyaidu alav edim shehu rasha. vechen im amru amana hayu devarenu en neemanim shehammeid al shetar amana kemeid besheker: 
Amru haedim shetar mecher ze modaa nimsera lanu alav af al pi shekketav yadan yotze mimmakom acher hare ellu neemanin: 
Amru al tenay haya shetar ze. im haya ketav yadan yotze mimmakom acher en neemanin veim en hashshetar mitkayyem ella mippihem neemanim. veomer levaale haddin kayyemu hattenay uvou ladun: 
Amar echad min haedim al tenay hayu haddevarim vehashsheni omer lo haya sham tenay hare kan ed echad: 
Gam bedine mamonot en mekabbelin edut ella bifne baal din. im haya baal din chole o shehayu haedim mevakkeshim lelech limdinat hayyam veshalchu levaal din velo ba hare ellu mekabbelim edim shello befanav. bamme devarim amurim beedut al pe. aval bishtar mekayyemin bet din et edav shello bifne baal din. vaafillu haya omed vetzoveach veomer shetar mezuyyaf hu ede sheker hen pesule edut hen en mashgichin bo ella mekayyemin et hashshetar veim yesh lo reaya lifsol yifsol: 
Kol mi sheyyesh lo reaya beedim metappel baedim ad sheyyeviem levet din. veim yadu bet din shebbaal dino allam vetaan hattovea shehaedim mitpachadim mibbaal dino sheyyavou veyaidu lo hare bet din kofin et baal dino sheyyavi hu haedim. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu danin bahen leallam:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 4:
Ede nefashot tzerichin sheyyihyu shenehem roim et haose avera keechad. utzerichin lehaid keechad uvevet din echad. aval dine mamonot en tzerichin lechach. ketzad. haya echad roehu mechallon ze kesheavar haavera vehaed haacher roehu mechallon acher. im hayu shene haedim roin ze et ze mitztarfin veim lav en mitztarfin. haya ze hammatre bo roe haedim vehaedim roin oto af al pi sheen roin ze et ze hammatre metzarfan. hayu shene haedim bevayit echad vehotzi echad mehen rosho min hachallon. veraahu ze sheose melacha beshabbat veechad matre bo. vehichnis rosho vechazar haed hashsheni vehotzi rosho meoto hachallon veraahu. en mitztarfin ad sheyyiru shenehem keechad. hayu shene edim roin oto mechallon ze ushene edim roin oto mechallon acher veechad matre bo baemtza. bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu hare zo edut achat veim lo hayu roin ellu et ellu velo tzeref otan hammatre hare ellu shete eduyot. lefichach im nimtzet kat achat mehen zommin hu vehen neheragin shehare hu neherag beedut hakkat hashsheniyya: 
Aval bedine mamonot af al pi shello rau ellu et ellu edutan mitztarefet. ketzad. amar haechad befanay hilvahu beyom peloni o befanay hoda lo. veamar haed hashsheni vechen ani meid shehilvahu befanay o hoda beyom acher. hare ellu mitztarfin: 
Vechen im amar haechad befanay hilvahu vehashsheni omer befanay hoda lo. o sheamar harishon befanay hoda vehashsheni sheheid achar zeman amar befanay hilvahu. hare ellu mitztarfin: 
Vechen beet shemmeidin bevet din yavo echad veshomin devarav hayyom uchesheyyavo haed hashsheni leachar zeman shomin devarav umitztarfin ze laze umotziin bahen hammamon: 
Vechen im haya ed echad bichtav veechad al pe mitztarfin. veim amar ze shello katav eduto ani kaniti miyyado al davar ze velo ba hammalve hazze velo shaal mimmenni lichtov shenehem mitztarfin laasot hammilve bashshetar veeno yachol lomar parati: 
Heid haechad bevet din ze vehaed hashsheni bevet din acher yavo bet din etzel bet din veyitztarfu edutan. vechen im heidu shene haedim bevet din ze vechazru veheidu bevet din acher yavo echad mikkol bet din veyitztarfu. aval haed im haddayyan sheheidu shene haedim befanav en mitztarfin: 
Af al pi shemmitztarfin haedut bedine mamonot tzarich sheyyaid kol echad mishshenehem bechol davar kemo shebbearnu. aval im heid ed echad bemiktzat davar veheid hashsheni bemiktzato en mekayyemin haddavar meedut shenehem. shenneemar <small>(mishna sota 6 3)</small> "al pi shenayim edim yakum davar". ketzad. ze omer peloni achal sade zo shana pelonit veze heid sheachalah shana sheniyya veze heid sheachalah shana shelishit. en mitztarfin edut shelashtan veomrim hare achalah shalosh shanim shekkol echad veechad heid bemiktzat haddavar. vechen im heid ze ani raiti saara achat betzad yemino shel ze veze omer ani raiti saara achat betzad semolo shel ze beoto hayyom. en mitztarfin divre shenehem kede shennomar hare heidu shenehem shehaya ze gadol beyom peloni lefi shekkol echad mehem lo heid ella bemiktzat hassimanin. afillu heidu shenayim besaara achat vehaidu shenayim besaara acheret shehare kol kat mehem heida al chatzi davar veen zo edut. aval im heida haachat sheraata shete searot betzad yamin veheida hashsheniyya sheraata shete searot betzad semol mitztarfin. vechen kol kayyotze bo:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 5:
En chotchin din min haddinin al pi ed echad lo dine mamonot velo dine nefashot. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 15)</small> "lo yakum ed echad beish lechol avon ulechol chattat". umippi hashshemua lamadnu shekkam hu lishvua kemo shebbearnu behilchot toen: 
Bishne mekomot heemina tora ed echad. besota shello tishte me marim uveegla arufa shello tearef kemo shebbearnu. vechen middivrehen beedut ishsha sheyyaid lah shemmet balah: 
Vechol makom sheed echad moil ishsha ufasul kemo chen meidim. chutz meed echad shel shevua sheen mechayyevin shevua ella beedut kasher harauy lehitztaref im acher veyitchayyev ze hannishba mamon al piv. al pi shenayim edim o al pi shelosha edim laasot shelosha kishnayim ma shenayim nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul batel haedut af shelosha vehu haddin lemea. nimtza echad mehen karov o pasul betela haedut ben bedine mamonot ben bedine nefashot: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman shennitkavvenu kullam lehaid. aval im lo nitkavvenu kullam lehaid ma yaasu shene achim bichlal haam verau haam kesheharag ze et ze o keshechaval bo o keshechataf chefetz miyyado: 
Vechetzad bodkin et haddavar. kesheyyavou levet din edim merubbin. kat achat omer lahem kesheritem ze sheharag o chaval lehaid batem o lirot. kol mi sheomer lo lehaid alav ella lirot ma haddavar uvichlal haam bati mafrishin oto. vechol mi sheomer lo hayiti omed ella lehaid ulechavven haedut mafrishin oto. im nimtza beellu shennitkavvenu lehaid karov o pasul edut kullam betela. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya bahen karov o pasul. aval im kullam kesherim echad shennitkavven lehaid o shello nitkavven lehaid hoil veraa haddavar vechivven eduto vehaya sham hateraa chotchin haddin al piv. ben bedine mamonot ben bedine nefashot: 
Shetar shehayu edav merubbin venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul o shehayu bahem shenayim kerovim ze laze. vahare en haedim kayyamin kede lishl otan. im yesh sham edut berura shekkullam yashvu lachtom shehare nitkavvenu lehaid hare ze batel. veim lav titkayyem haedut bashshear. velamma mekayyemin haedut bashshear shehare efshar shechatmu hakkesherim vehinnichu makom laggadol lachtom uva ze hakkarov o happasul vechatam shello middatam: 
Af al pi shehaed shechatum mittechilla bashshetar hu happasul hare hashshetar kasher: 
Kol ed sheheid bedine nefashot eno more bedin ze hanneherag velo yelammed alav lo zechut velo chova. veim amar yesh li lelammed alav zechut meshattekin oto shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar la 30)</small> "veed echad lo yaane venefesh lamut". ben lizchut ben lechova. umahu ze shenneemar lamut kelomar ed sheheid benefesh lamut lo yaane davar ella yaid veyishtok. aval bedine mamonot yesh lo lelammed alav zechut o chova. aval lo yimmane im haddayyanim velo yease dayyan sheen ed naase dayyan afillu bedine mamonot: 
Bamme devarim amurim bedavar shetztzarich edim min hattora vetzarich dayyanim ladun beoto haddavar min hattora. aval beshel divrehem ed naase dayyan. ketzad. echad shehevi hagget veamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam. hu ushenayim notnin oto lah venimtza keillu netaluhu mibbet din. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 6:
Kevar bearnu shekkiyyum shetarot middivrehem kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin. af al pi chen en mekayyemin shetarot ella bishlosha afillu shelashtan hedyotot mippene shehu din. ulefichach en mekayyemin shetarot ballayla kemo shebbearnu: 
Beechad mechamishsha derachim mitkayyem hashshetar bevet din. hadderech haechad sheyyihyu dayyanim makkirin ketav yede haedim shezzo edut peloni vezo edut peloni. hadderech hashsheni sheyyachtemu haedim bifnehem. hadderech hashshelishi sheyyavou haedim hachatumim bifnehem veyomar kol echad veechad ze ketav yadi vaani ed baddavar hazze. hadderech harvii sheim metu ede hashshetar o shehayu bimdina acheret yavou edim veyaidu al ketav yadan shehu ze. hadderech hachamishi sheyyihye ketav yadan yotze mishshetarot acherim veorchin bet din ze hakketav leoto hakketav shebbishtarot acherim veyihye dome ze laze veyerae lahem beyachad shekketav yede ellu hu ketav yede ellu: 
En mekayyemin et hashshetar mishshetarot acherim ella mishshene shetarot shel shete sadot sheachalum baalehen shalosh shanim achila geluya nechona belo shum yira velo pachad mittevia baolam kederech sheochlin kol baale sadot sedotehen. o mishshene shitre ketubbot. vehu sheyyetzu shene hashshetarot mittachat yede acher lo mittachat yede ze sherotze lekayyem shetaro shemma hu ziyyef hakkol. vechen mekayyemin hashshetar mishshetar shekkara alav arar vehuchzak bevet din mekayyemin mimmennu levaddo kemo shemmekayyemin mishshetar shete sadot o mishshete ketubbot: 
Bet din shekkatvu bemoshav shelosha hayinu venitkayyem shetar ze befanenu hare ze mekuyyam af al pi shello pershu bee ze derech mechamishsha derachim nitkayyem. sheen choshshin levet din shemma yitu. uchevar nahagu kol batte dinin sherainu veshamanu sheyyichtevu hadderech shennitkayyem bah lifnehem: 
Uleolam en bet din bodkin achar bet din acher ella machazikin otan shehen bekiin velo yitu. aval bodkin achar haedim: 
Shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar umet echad mehem tzerichin lichtov bemoshav shelosha hayinu vehaechad enennu. shemma yomar haroe bet din bishnayim kiyyemuhu. afillu haya katuv bo bevet din yomar shemma dimmu sheshshenayim bet din hem. veim yesh bo mashma shehayu shelosha eno tzarich: 
Shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar uvau shene edim veiraru al echad mehen shehu gazlan vechayyotze bo uvau shenayim acherim veheidu shechazar bitshuva. im ad shello chatmu heidu shechazar hare ze chotem immahem shehare shelosha hayu veim achar shechatmu hashshenayim heidu alav shechazar bitshuva eno chotem immahen shehare hu kemi sheeno beet chatimat hashshenayim. bamme devarim amurim kesheiraru alav baavera. aval iraru alav bifgam mishpacha kemo sheamru immo lo nishtachrera veeved hu o lo nitgayyera veakkum hu venoda achar shechatmu hashshenayim sheen bemishpachto pegam veshehu kasher hare ze chotem immahem shezze gilluy davar shehaya mikkodem hu: 
Muttar lichtov hakkiyyum bashshetar kodem sheyyitkayyem hashshetar sheen hakketiva ikkar ella hachatima. veen haddayyanim tzerichin likrot hashshetar shemmekayyemin oto ella mekayyemin oto meedav af al pi shello yadu ma katuv bo:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 7:
Meid karov al ketav kerovo. ketzad. shetar sheedav reuven veshimon umetu o shehalchu limdinat hayyam uva beno shel reuven veamar ze ketav yado shel avi uva beno shel shimon veamar ze ketav yado shel avi hare ellu kishne edim kesherim sheenan kerovim veim yitztaref immahem shelishi veheid al ketav yadan shel shenehem hare nitkayyem hashshetar: 
Veellu middevarim shenneemanim haggedolim lehaid begadlam ma sherau bekatnam. neeman adam lomar keshehu gadol zehu ketav yado shel avi zehu ketav yado shel rabbi zehu ketav yado shel achi shehayiti makkir bichtav yadam keshehayiti katan. vehu sheyyitztaref immo acher shemmakkir ketav yadan keshehu gadol: 
Shetar sheedav reuven veshimon uvau shenayim veheidu shezze ketav yado shel reuven veze ketav yado shel shimon nitkayyem hashshetar. aval im heid ze al ketav yado [shel] reuven vehashsheni heid al ketav yado [shel] shimon lo nitkayyem hashshetar lefi shetztzarich shene edim al ketav [kol] yad echad mishshenehem. veim yesh shelishi meid al ketav reuven veshimon keechad nitkayyem: 
Amar harishon ze ketav yadi veheid hu veacher al ketav yede hashsheni lo nitkayyem lefi shennimtza sheloshet rive hammamon shebbashshetar taluy beedut haechad. vechen im heid achiv o beno shel rishon im acher al ketav yede hashsheni lo nitkayyem shehare sheloshet rive hammamon taluy beedut hakkerovim: 
Shenayim shechatumin al hashshetar umet echad mehen tzarich shene edim lehaid al ketav yado shel met veim lo nimtza ella ed echad im ze haed hachay kotev chatimat yado bifne edim afillu al hacheres umashlicho bevet din ad shettuchzak ketav yado bevet din velo yihye tzarich lomar shezze ketav yado veyaid hu veacher al ketav yede hammet veyitkayyem ketav yado shello befanav: 
Shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar shenayim mehen makkirin chatimat yede edim veechad eno makkir. ad shello chatmu meidin befanav vechotem. shehaedim naasim dayyanim bedavar shehu middivrehem kemo shebbearnu. aval achar shechatmu en meidin befanav vechotem [shehare beet shechatmu lo hayu makkirin ella hashshenayim] veen mekayyemin ella ad sheyyihyu shelashtan makkirin o yaidu haedim al hakketav bifne kol echad veechad: 
Shenayim shehayu chatumin al hashshetar umetu uvau shenayim veamru ketav yadan hu ze aval anusim hayu ketannim hayu pesule edut hayu. af al pi sheyyesh sham edim acherim shezze ketav yadan o shehaya ketav yadan yotze mishshetar acher shekkara alav arar vehuchzak bevet din hare ze lo nitkayyem. ella meidin hashshenayim shebbashshetar keneged hashshenayim sheheidu alehen shehen pesulin veen govin bo kelum:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 8:
Mi shechatam al hashshetar uva lehaid al ketav yado bevet din vehikkir ketav yado shezzehu bevadday aval eno zocher haedut kelal velo yimmatze belibbo zikkaron kelal shezze lava mizze leolam. hare ze asur lehaid al ketav yado shehu ze bevet din. sheen adam meid al ketav yado shehu ze ella al hammamon shebbashshetar hu meid shezze chayyav laze. uchetav yado hu kede lehazekiro haddavar aval im lo nizkar lo yaid: 
Echad hazzocher et haedut veechad sheraa ketav yado o shehizkiruhu acherim venizkar. afillu hizkiro haed hashsheni sheheid im nizkar hare ze meid. aval im hizkir oto hattovea atzmo af al pi shennizkar eno meid mippene shezze dome beene baal din keillu heid sheker bedavar shello yada: 
Lefichach im haya hattovea talmid chacham vehizkir hattovea hazze et haed venizkar hare ze yaid lo shettalmid chacham yodea sheillu lo zachar haddavar lo haya meid. vekal hu shehekellu bedine mamonot sheaf al pi sheshshachach haddavar mikkamma shanim vehakketav hu shehizkiro hare ze meid: 
Hoil vehaddavar ken shetar sheyyatza levet din uvau edim veamru ketav yadenu hu ze aval meolam lo yadanu edut zo veen anu zochrim shezze lava mizze o machar lo. lo nitkayyem hashshetar vahare hen kechershim ad sheyyizkeru edutan. vechol mi sheeno dan ken lo yada bedine mamonot ben yemino lismolo. aval im haya ketav yadan yotze mimmakom acher o shehayu sham edim shezze ketav yadan. mekayyemin et hashshetar veen mashgichin al divrehen sheomrin en anu zochrin edut zo shemma chazru bahen. veze sheamru en anu zochrin kede levattel hashshetar ucheillu amru ketannim hayinu pesule edut hayinu sheenan neemanim hoil umitkayyem hashshetar shello al pihem. umippene taam ze mekayyemin kol hashshetarot. veen anu tzerichin lehavi edim velishl otam im hem zochrim edut zo o enam zochrim otah. sheafillu bau veamru en anu zochrim otah en shomin lahen hoil veefshar lekayyemo shello mippihen: 
Echad hakkotev eduto al hashshetar. o shennimtza etzlo katuv befinkaso bichtav yado peloni heid oti alav beyom peloni bechach vechach. im zachar meatzmo o hizkiruhu acherim venizkar meid veim lav asur lehaid. sheen ze dome ella lemi sheamar lo adam neeman peloni yesh lo etzel peloni kach vechach veheid hu sheyyesh laze etzel ze vehu eno yodea min haddavar kelum ella mippi haacher shama veheid:
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 9:
Asara mine paslut hem kol mi shennimtza bo echad mehen hare hu pasul leedut. veellu hen. hannashim. vehaavadim. vehakketannim. vehashshotim. vehachershim. vehassumim. veharshaim. vehabbezuyin. vehakkerovin. vehannogin beedutan. hare ellu asara: 
Nashim pesulot leedut min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 6)</small> "al pi shenayim edim" lashon zachar velo lashon nekeva: 
Vechen hattumtum vehaanderoginus pesulin mippene shehen safek ishsha. vechol mi shehu safek kasher safek pasul hare hu pasul sheen haed ba ella lehotzi mamon al piv o lechayyev al piv veen motziin mamon missafek veen onshin missafek din tora: 
Haavadim pesulin leedut min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 19 19)</small> "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv" mikkelal sheachiv kamohu ma achiv ben berit af haed ben berit kal vachomer leakkum im avadim shehen bemiktzat mitzvot pesulin haakkum lo kol shekken: 
Mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin pasul: 
Kol mi shennishtachrer vahare hu mechussar get shichrur. pasul ad sheyyaggia get leyado veyease mikkelal bene berit veachar kach yaid: 
Hakketannim pesulin leedut min hattora shenneemar beedim <small>(Devarim 19 17)</small> "veamdu shene haanashim" anashim velo ketannim. afillu haya hakkatan navon vechacham hare hu pasul ad sheyyavi shete searot achar shelosh esre shana gemurot. veim higgia leesrim shana velo hevi shete searot venolad bo siman missimane serus hare ze saris veyaid. veim lo nolad bo lo yaid ad rov shenotav kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut: 
Katan shehiggia lichlal shenotav shenniru bo simane bagrut millemala eno tzarich bedika. veim lav en mekabbelin eduto ad sheyyibbadek. uven shelosh esre shana veyom echad shehevi shete searot veeno yodea betiv massa umattan en eduto edut bekarkaot mippene sheeno medakdek bidvarim shehare eno yodea. aval beedut mittaltelin mekabbelin eduto hoil vehu gadol: 
Hashshote pasul leedut min hattora lefi sheeno ben mitzvot. velo shote shehu mehallech arom umeshabber kelim vezorek avanim bilvad. ella kol mi shennitrefa dato venimtzet dato meshubbeshet tamid bedavar min haddevarim af al pi shehu medabber veshoel kainyan bishar devarim hare ze pasul uvichlal shotim yechashev. hannichpe beet kefiyyato pasul uveet shehu bari kasher. veechad hannichpe mizzeman lizman o hannichpe tamid belo et kavua. vehu shello tihye dato meshubbeshet tamid shehare yesh sham nichpim sheggam beet beriutam datam mittarefet alehem. vetzarich lehityashshev beedut hannichpin harebe: 
Happetaim beyoter sheen makkirin devarim shessotrin ze et ze velo yavinu inyene haddavar kederech shemmevinin shear am haaretz. vechen hamevohalim vehannechpazim bedatam vehammishtaggeim beyoter hare ellu bichlal hashshotim. vedavar ze lefi (ma) sheyyire haddayyan shei efshar lechavven haddaat bichtav: 
Hacheresh keshote sheen dato nechona veeno ben mitzvot. veechad cheresh medabber veeno shomea o shomea veeno medabber. af al pi sheriyyato reiyya meulla vedato nechona tzarich lehaid bevet din befiv. o sheyyihye rauy lehaid befiv. veyihye rauy lishmoa haddayyanim vehaiyyum shemmeayyemin alav. vechen im nishtattek af al pi shennivdak bederech shebbodkin leinyan gittin venimtzet eduto mechuvvenet veheid befanenu bichtav yado enah edut kelal. chutz meedut ishsha lefi shebbeiggunah hekellu: 
Hassumim af al pi shemmakkirin hakkol veyadu haanashim hare ellu pesulin min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "vehu ed o raa" mi shehu rauy lirot hu shemmeid. vehassuma beachat meenav kasher lehaid:
